faqs.q: What is the difference between chemotherapy and immunotherapy?
faqs.a: Chemotherapy uses cytotoxic medications to target and destroy rapidly dividing cancer cells throughout the body. Immunotherapy trains your body's natural immune system to recognize and eliminate specific cancer cells with fewer side effects on healthy tissue.

faqs.q: What is targeted cancer therapy, and is it available at DHS Hospital?
faqs.a: Targeted therapy uses precision drugs that block specific genes, proteins, or cellular pathways driving tumor growth. Dr. Dileep Srinivasan provides advanced targeted therapy protocols tailored to individual tumor genetic profiling.
